q: 老师说得太快，我听___懂。
zh: 老师说得太快，我听不懂。
py: lǎo shī shuō de tài kuài wǒ tīng bù dǒng
en: The teacher speaks too fast; I can't understand.
why: 太快 is the reason for failing, so 不 goes between 听 and 懂: 听不懂. 没 cannot sit inside verb + result, and 别 is an imperative.

q: 你的声音太小，我___不见。
zh: 你的声音太小，我听不见。
py: nǐ de shēng yīn tài xiǎo wǒ tīng bù jiàn
en: Your voice is too quiet; I can't hear you.
why: Voices are heard, so the verb is 听 and 听不见 means cannot hear. 看不见 would mean cannot see, and 说不见 is not a word.

q: 昨天的作业我___做完。
zh: 昨天的作业我没做完。
py: zuó tiān de zuò yè wǒ méi zuò wán
en: I didn't finish yesterday's homework.
why: 昨天 reports one finished occasion that did not happen, so 没 + verb + result. 不 here would be a flat refusal, and the potential 做不完 puts 不 after the verb, not before it.

q: 这个词我在词典里找了半天，还是找___到。
zh: 这个词我在词典里找了半天，还是找不到。
py: zhè ge cí wǒ zài cí diǎn lǐ zhǎo le bàn tiān hái shi zhǎo bù dào
en: I looked for this word in the dictionary for ages and still can't find it.
why: 还是 after a long search shows the failure continues, so 找不到 'cannot find'. 找得到 says the opposite, and 没 cannot go between 找 and 到.

q: 别担心，现在去图书馆还借___到那本书。
zh: 别担心，现在去图书馆还借得到那本书。
py: bié dān xīn xiàn zài qù tú shū guǎn hái jiè de dào nà běn shū
en: Don't worry, if you go to the library now you can still borrow that book.
why: 别担心 and 还 reassure that it is still possible, so the positive 得 goes between 借 and 到. 不 would say the opposite, and 没 cannot go inside the block.

q: 白板上的字太小，坐在后面的同学看___清楚。
zh: 白板上的字太小，坐在后面的同学看不清楚。
py: bái bǎn shàng de zì tài xiǎo zuò zài hòu miàn de tóng xué kàn bù qīng chu
en: The writing on the whiteboard is too small; the students at the back can't see it clearly.
why: 太小 gives the reason for failure, so 不 goes between 看 and 清楚. 得 would claim they can see it, and 没 cannot sit inside the verb-result block.

q: 你说慢一点儿，我就听___懂。
zh: 你说慢一点儿，我就听得懂。
py: nǐ shuō màn yī diǎn r wǒ jiù tīng de dǒng
en: If you speak a bit more slowly, I'll be able to understand.
why: The condition 说慢一点儿 promises success, so the positive 得: 听得懂. 听不懂 would contradict the condition, and 了 cannot link a verb to its result.

q: 这份报告的数据太乱了，我整理了一个晚上也整理___好。
zh: 这份报告的数据太乱了，我整理了一个晚上也整理不好。
py: zhè fèn bào gào de shù jù tài luàn le wǒ zhěng lǐ le yī ge wǎn shang yě zhěng lǐ bù hǎo
en: The data in this report is so messy that I couldn't get it sorted even after a whole evening.
why: 太乱了 and 也 (even after a whole evening) show repeated failure: 整理不好 'cannot manage to sort it out'. 得 would mean it can be done, and 没 is not placed between verb and result.

q: 门锁着，我们进___去。
zh: 门锁着，我们进不去。
py: mén suǒ zhe wǒ men jìn bù qù
en: The door is locked; we can't get in.
why: A locked door is a physical obstacle, so 不 goes between 进 and 去: 进不去. 进得去 says the opposite, and 没 cannot sit inside the block.

q: 你在山上，山太陡了，我爬不上___。
zh: 你在山上，山太陡了，我爬不上去。
py: nǐ zài shān shàng shān tài dǒu le wǒ pá bù shàng qù
en: You are up on the mountain, and it is too steep for me to climb up there.
why: You are up there, away from the speaker, so the direction word is 去. 来 would mean toward the speaker, and 回 would mean going back.

q: 新桌子到了门口，门太小，搬不___去。
zh: 新桌子到了门口，门太小，搬不进去。
py: xīn zhuō zi dào le mén kǒu mén tài xiǎo bān bù jìn qù
en: The new desk has reached the doorway, but the door is too small to carry it in.
why: The desk is outside and has to go into the room, so the direction is 进: 搬不进去. 出 would take it out of a room, and 回 would send it back.

q: 他的电话号码，我想___起来了。
zh: 他的电话号码，我想不起来了。
py: tā de diàn huà hào mǎ wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái le
en: I can't remember his phone number any more.
why: 想不起来 is the set form for failing to recall; 不 goes between 想 and 起来. 没 and 别 cannot go inside it, and the final 了 means 'now, any more'.

q: 我记得去年在会上见过这位客户，可是怎么也想___起来他叫什么。
zh: 我记得去年在会上见过这位客户，可是怎么也想不起来他叫什么。
py: wǒ jì de qù nián zài huì shàng jiàn guò zhè wèi kè hù kě shì zěn me yě xiǎng bù qǐ lái tā jiào shén me
en: I remember meeting this client at a meeting last year, but I just can't recall his name.
why: 怎么也 'no matter how' signals persistent failure, so 想不起来. 想得起来 would make the sentence illogical, and 没 cannot go inside the block.

q: 开了一上午会，腿都麻了，我一下子站___起来。
zh: 开了一上午会，腿都麻了，我一下子站不起来。
py: kāi le yī shàng wǔ huì tuǐ dōu má le wǒ yī xià zi zhàn bù qǐ lái
en: After a whole morning of meetings my legs are numb and I can't stand up right away.
why: Numb legs are the obstacle, so 站不起来. 站得起来 would deny the problem the first clause states, and 没 sits outside the block.

q: 这本词典太贵了，我买不___。
zh: 这本词典太贵了，我买不起。
py: zhè běn cí diǎn tài guì le wǒ mǎi bù qǐ
en: This dictionary is too expensive; I can't afford it.
why: 太贵 means price is the obstacle, so 起 'afford': 买不起. 买不到 means none can be found for sale, and 买不完 means too much to finish buying.

q: 那本词典早就卖完了，现在书店里买不___。
zh: 那本词典早就卖完了，现在书店里买不到。
py: nà běn cí diǎn zǎo jiù mài wán le xiàn zài shū diàn lǐ mǎi bù dào
en: That dictionary sold out long ago; now you can't buy it in the bookstore.
why: 卖完了 means none is available, so 买不到 'cannot get hold of it'. 买不起 is about price, which the sentence never mentions, and 买不下 is not a form for this.

q: 我已经很饱了，一口也吃不___了。
zh: 我已经很饱了，一口也吃不下了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng hěn bǎo le yī kǒu yě chī bù xià le
en: I'm already full; I can't eat even one more bite.
why: Being full means there is no room left, which is 吃不下. 吃不完 is about too much food to finish, but 一口也 shows the problem is room, not quantity.

q: 这么多菜，我们三个人吃到明天也吃不___。
zh: 这么多菜，我们三个人吃到明天也吃不完。
py: zhè me duō cài wǒ men sān ge rén chī dào míng tiān yě chī bù wán
en: There is so much food that the three of us couldn't finish it even by tomorrow.
why: The problem is the quantity, so 完 'finish': 吃不完. 吃不下 is about having no room in the stomach, which does not fit 吃到明天, and 起 is about money.

q: 现在去机场，已经来___及了。
zh: 现在去机场，已经来不及了。
py: xiàn zài qù jī chǎng yǐ jīng lái bù jí le
en: It is already too late to go to the airport now.
why: 已经 and 了 say time has run out: 来不及. 来得及 means there is still time, and 来没及 is not a form.

q: 离考试还有一个星期，现在开始复习还来___及。
zh: 离考试还有一个星期，现在开始复习还来得及。
py: lí kǎo shì hái yǒu yī ge xīng qī xiàn zài kāi shǐ fù xí hái lái de jí
en: The exam is still a week away, so it is not too late to start revising now.
why: 还有一个星期 means time remains, so 来得及. 来不及 would say it is too late, and 来没及 is not a form.

q: 明天有考试，我现在紧张得怎么也睡___着。
zh: 明天有考试，我现在紧张得怎么也睡不着。
py: míng tiān yǒu kǎo shì wǒ xiàn zài jǐn zhāng de zěn me yě shuì bù zháo
en: I have an exam tomorrow and I'm so nervous I can't fall asleep no matter what.
why: 怎么也 shows repeated failure: 睡不着 'cannot fall asleep'. 睡得着 would be the opposite, and 睡没着 is not a form (it would be 没睡着).

q: 公司在市中心，那里的房租太高，刚毕业的学生都租___起。
zh: 公司在市中心，那里的房租太高，刚毕业的学生都租不起。
py: gōng sī zài shì zhōng xīn nà lǐ de fáng zū tài gāo gāng bì yè de xué sheng dōu zū bù qǐ
en: The company is in the city centre, where rents are so high that fresh graduates can't afford them.
why: 房租太高 is the price obstacle, so 租不起 'cannot afford to rent'. 租得起 contradicts it, and 了 does not link a verb and 起.

q: 对___起，我上课迟到了。
zh: 对不起，我上课迟到了。
py: duì bù qǐ wǒ shàng kè chí dào le
en: Sorry, I was late for class.
why: 对不起 is a fixed apology with 不 in the middle. 对得起 means 'to be worthy of, not let down', and 对没起 does not exist.

q: 明天我有事，去___了。
zh: 明天我有事，去不了。
py: míng tiān wǒ yǒu shì qù bù liǎo
en: I have something on tomorrow; I can't go.
why: With no result word, 不 + 了 (liǎo) says the action cannot happen: 去不了. 有事 is the obstacle, so 去得了 is wrong, and 没 cannot go inside the block.

q: 我发烧了，想去也___，你们去吧。
zh: 我发烧了，想去也去不了，你们去吧。
py: wǒ fā shāo le xiǎng qù yě qù bù liǎo nǐ men qù ba
en: I have a fever; even if I wanted to go I couldn't, so you go ahead.
why: 想去也 'even if I want to' sets up inability, so 去不了 (liǎo). 不去了 means 'decided not to go after all' and does not fit a wish that is blocked.

q: 天气太冷，我决定___，在家复习。
zh: 天气太冷，我决定不去了，在家复习。
py: tiān qì tài lěng wǒ jué dìng bù qù le zài jiā fù xí
en: It's too cold; I've decided not to go after all and will revise at home.
why: 决定 expresses a choice, so 不去了 'not going any more' (le). 去不了 expresses inability and cannot follow 决定.

q: 这么多文件，一个人一天处理___了。
zh: 这么多文件，一个人一天处理不了。
py: zhè me duō wén jiàn yī ge rén yī tiān chǔ lǐ bù liǎo
en: One person can't deal with this many documents in a day.
why: 这么多 gives the quantity obstacle, so 处理不了 (liǎo). 得 would claim it is easy, and 没 cannot go inside the block.

q: 办公室的空调坏了，太热了，我受___了。
zh: 办公室的空调坏了，太热了，我受不了。
py: bàn gōng shì de kōng tiáo huài le tài rè le wǒ shòu bù liǎo
en: The office air conditioning is broken; it is too hot and I can't stand it.
why: 受不了 (liǎo) is the set form for 'cannot bear it'. 没 and 别 cannot go inside it.

q: 这个问题太难了，我回答___了。
zh: 这个问题太难了，我回答不了。
py: zhè ge wèn tí tài nán le wǒ huí dá bù liǎo
en: This question is too hard; I can't answer it.
why: 太难了 is the obstacle, so 回答不了 (liǎo). 回答得了 would say the opposite, and 没 cannot go inside the block.

q: 别担心，这点儿文件我一个人拿___了。
zh: 别担心，这点儿文件我一个人拿得了。
py: bié dān xīn zhè diǎn r wén jiàn wǒ yī ge rén ná de liǎo
en: Don't worry, I can carry this small pile of documents by myself.
why: 别担心 reassures, so the positive 拿得了 (liǎo). 拿不了 would worry rather than reassure, and 没 cannot go inside the block.

q: 李老师在课堂上说的那些话，我一辈子也忘___了。
zh: 李老师在课堂上说的那些话，我一辈子也忘不了。
py: lǐ lǎo shī zài kè táng shàng shuō de nà xiē huà wǒ yī bèi zi yě wàng bù liǎo
en: I won't forget what Teacher Li said in class as long as I live.
why: 一辈子也 'not even in a lifetime' calls for 忘不了 (liǎo). 忘得了 would say you can forget, which reverses the meaning.

q: 里面在开会，你___。
zh: 里面在开会，你不能进去。
py: lǐ miàn zài kāi huì nǐ bù néng jìn qù
en: There is a meeting going on inside; you're not allowed in.
why: A meeting is a rule-based reason, so 'not allowed' is 不能进去. 进不去 is physical inability, as with a locked door or a packed room.

q: 门锁着，我怎么也___。
zh: 门锁着，我怎么也进不去。
py: mén suǒ zhe wǒ zěn me yě jìn bù qù
en: The door is locked and I can't get in no matter what I do.
why: 怎么也 shows trying and failing, which is inability: 进不去. 不能进去 is about permission and does not combine with 怎么也.

q: 这个箱子太重了，我用了很大力气也___。
zh: 这个箱子太重了，我用了很大力气也拿不动。
py: zhè ge xiāng zi tài zhòng le wǒ yòng le hěn dà lì qi yě ná bù dòng
en: This suitcase is too heavy; I can't lift it even with all my strength.
why: Weight and effort point to physical inability: 拿不动. 不能拿 would say 'must not take it' and does not fit the effort.

q: 这是公司的机密文件，你们___。
zh: 这是公司的机密文件，你们不能带走。
py: zhè shì gōng sī de jī mì wén jiàn nǐ men bù néng dài zǒu
en: These are confidential company files; you must not take them away.
why: 机密 means a rule forbids it, so 不能带走. 带不走 would say you are physically unable to take them away.

q: 图书馆规定这套珍藏本只能在馆内阅读，读者___。
zh: 图书馆规定这套珍藏本只能在馆内阅读，读者不能带出去。
py: tú shū guǎn guī dìng zhè tào zhēn cáng běn zhǐ néng zài guǎn nèi yuè dú dú zhě bù néng dài chū qù
en: The library rule is that this rare edition can only be read inside, so readers are not allowed to take it out.
why: 规定 and 只能 mark a rule, so 不能带出去. 带不出去 would mean readers are physically unable to carry it out.

q: 办公室在六楼，电梯坏了，这么大的柜子，我们三个人也___。
zh: 办公室在六楼，电梯坏了，这么大的柜子，我们三个人也抬不上去。
py: bàn gōng shì zài liù lóu diàn tī huài le zhè me dà de guì zi wǒ men sān ge rén yě tái bù shàng qù
en: The office is on the sixth floor and the lift is broken; the three of us can't carry such a big cabinet up.
why: Size and a broken lift are physical obstacles, so 抬不上去. 不能抬上去 would mean someone forbids carrying it up.

q: 昨天的作文我写___，老师给了我九十分。
zh: 昨天的作文我写得很好，老师给了我九十分。
py: zuó tiān de zuò wén wǒ xiě de hěn hǎo lǎo shī gěi le wǒ jiǔ shí fēn
en: I wrote yesterday's essay very well, and the teacher gave me ninety.
why: 九十分 shows the essay was done well, the degree pattern 写得很好. 写不好 'cannot write it well' and 写得不好 'writes it badly' both contradict the score.

q: 这个字太难了，我怎么写也写___。
zh: 这个字太难了，我怎么写也写不好。
py: zhè ge zì tài nán le wǒ zěn me xiě yě xiě bù hǎo
en: This character is too hard; however I write it, I can't get it right.
why: 太难了 and 怎么写也 describe repeated failure, so potential 写不好. 得很好 and 得挺好 would say the character is written well, which contradicts the sentence.

q: 他的汉语说___，常常帮同事翻译。
zh: 他的汉语说得很好，常常帮同事翻译。
py: tā de hàn yǔ shuō de hěn hǎo cháng cháng bāng tóng shì fān yì
en: He speaks Chinese very well and often interprets for colleagues.
why: Interpreting for colleagues shows how well he speaks, the degree pattern 说得很好. 说不好 would mean he cannot say it well, and 说不了 is not a fit here.

q: 这些生词我___记不住。
zh: 这些生词我记不住。
py: zhè xiē shēng cí wǒ jì bù zhù
en: I can't remember these new words.
why: A potential complement only says whether something can be done, so 把 cannot be used; the object is simply fronted as a topic: 这些生词我记不住.

q: 这篇课文太长了，我___背不下来。
zh: 这篇课文太长了，我背不下来。
py: zhè piān kè wén tài cháng le wǒ bèi bù xià lái
en: This text is too long; I can't learn it by heart.
why: 背不下来 is a potential complement, which never takes 把. The sentence is complete without it, with the object as the topic at the front.

q: 这份中文报纸你看得懂看___懂？
zh: 这份中文报纸你看得懂看不懂？
py: zhè fèn zhōng wén bào zhǐ nǐ kàn de dǒng kàn bù dǒng
en: Can you understand this Chinese newspaper or not?
why: The full positive + negative pair needs 不 to complete 看不懂. 没 cannot negate a potential form, and 吗 never goes inside the pair.

q: 你看___看得懂这份英文合同？
zh: 你看不看得懂这份英文合同？
py: nǐ kàn bù kàn de dǒng zhè fèn yīng wén hé tong
en: Can you understand this English contract?
why: The short form V不V得R repeats only the verb with 不: 看不看得懂. 没 cannot negate a potential form, and 吗 does not go inside the question.

zh: 你们听得见听不见？
py: nǐ men tīng de jiàn tīng bù jiàn
en: Can you hear it or not?
why: Ask with the full positive + negative pair, 听得见听不见. 听得见不见 cuts the negative half down to the complement alone, which is not a form.

zh: 我听不懂他的话。
py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng tā de huà
en: I can't understand what he says.
why: 听不懂 is one unit; the object follows it, or goes in front as a topic. The object cannot be put between 听 and 懂.

zh: 我想不起来他的电话号码了。
py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái tā de diàn huà hào mǎ le
en: I can't remember his phone number any more.
why: The object follows the whole 想不起来 block or is fronted as a topic, and the sentence-final 了 comes after the object.

zh: 现在去已经来不及了。
py: xiàn zài qù yǐ jīng lái bù jí le
en: It is already too late to go there now.
why: 已经 comes before 来不及, and 了 closes the sentence. 来不及 is a fixed unit and 现在去 stays in front of it.

zh: 今天我来不了。
py: jīn tiān wǒ lái bù liǎo
en: I can't come today.
why: 来不了 (liǎo) is the unit; the time word may stand before or after the subject but both stay in front of the verb.

zh: 你不能带走这些资料。
py: nǐ bù néng dài zǒu zhè xiē zī liào
en: You must not take these documents away.
why: Not allowed is 不能 + verb, and the object either follows the verb or is fronted as a topic. 不能 comes before 带走.

zh: 这个字太难了，我写不好。
py: zhè ge zì tài nán le wǒ xiě bù hǎo
en: This character is too hard; I can't write it well.
why: The reason clause comes first and the potential 写不好 follows. Nothing is inserted between 写 and 好.

zh: 你听不听得见老师的声音？
py: nǐ tīng bù tīng de jiàn lǎo shī de shēng yīn
en: Can you hear the teacher's voice?
why: V不V得R: the verb is repeated with 不, then the full 听得见. The object comes after the whole question block or in front as a topic.

zh: 你看得见黑板上的字吗？
py: nǐ kàn de jiàn hēi bǎn shàng de zì ma
en: Can you see the writing on the blackboard?
why: Question with 吗: the potential form stays whole and 吗 closes the sentence. 吗 cannot be put before 看得见.

zh: 离开会还有二十分钟，现在去来得及吗？
py: lí kāi huì hái yǒu èr shí fēn zhōng xiàn zài qù lái de jí ma
en: The meeting starts in twenty minutes; will we make it if we go now?
why: The time limit comes first, then the action, then 来得及 and 吗. 来得及 follows the action it is about.

zh: 门太小了，桌子搬不进去。
py: mén tài xiǎo le zhuō zi bān bù jìn qù
en: The door is too small; the table can't be carried in.
why: 搬不进去 is the unit, with 不 between 搬 and 进去. The reason can come first or last, but 不 never goes before 搬.

src_py: wǒ tīng dǒng le lǎo shī de huà
task: Say you can't understand it.
zh: 我听不懂老师的话。
py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng lǎo shī de huà
en: I can't understand what the teacher says.
why: Put 不 between verb and result: 听不懂. The 了 of the completed action goes, and the object follows the block or comes first as a topic.

src_py: wǒ zhǎo dào le nà fèn wén jiàn
task: Say you can't find it.
zh: 我找不到那份文件。
py: wǒ zhǎo bù dào nà fèn wén jiàn
en: I can't find that document.
why: Inability is 找不到, with 不 inside the verb-result block. 不找到 and 没找得到 are both wrong.

src_py: xiǎo wáng zuò wán le zhè ge biǎo gé
task: Say he can't finish it.
zh: 小王做不完这个表格。
py: xiǎo wáng zuò bù wán zhè ge biǎo gé
en: Xiao Wang can't finish this form.
why: 做完 becomes 做不完 by putting 不 in the middle; the completion 了 is dropped because the potential form does not take it.

src_py: zuó tiān de kè wǒ tīng bù dǒng
task: Say you did not understand it (one occasion), using 没.
zh: 昨天的课我没听懂。
py: zuó tiān de kè wǒ méi tīng dǒng
en: I didn't understand yesterday's class.
why: For one finished occasion, 没 goes before verb + result: 没听懂. The potential 听不懂 describes ability instead.

src_py: wǒ kàn de dǒng zhè fèn bào gào
task: Make it negative.
zh: 我看不懂这份报告。
py: wǒ kàn bù dǒng zhè fèn bào gào
en: I can't understand this report.
why: Negate a potential form by changing 得 to 不, not by adding 不 or 没 in front: 看不懂.

src_py: rén hěn shǎo wǒ men jìn de qù
task: The place is packed: say we can't get in.
zh: 人太多了，我们进不去。
py: rén tài duō le wǒ men jìn bù qù
en: There are too many people; we can't get in.
why: A crowd is a physical obstacle, so 不 replaces 得: 进不去. 不能进去 would mean it is not allowed.

src_py: wǒ xiǎng qǐ lái tā de míng zi le
task: Say you can't recall it.
zh: 我想不起来他的名字了。
py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái tā de míng zi le
en: I can't remember his name any more.
why: 想起来 becomes 想不起来 with 不 inserted before the direction word; the final 了 stays after the object.

src_py: wǒ pá de shàng nà zuò shān
task: Say it is too high and you can't climb it.
zh: 山太高了，我爬不上去。
py: shān tài gāo le wǒ pá bù shàng qù
en: The mountain is too high; I can't climb up it.
why: Inability is 爬不上去, with 不 inside the verb-direction block and 去 for a place away from the speaker.

src_py: wǒ jīn wǎn huí de lái
task: Say you can't get back tonight.
zh: 我今晚回不来。
py: wǒ jīn wǎn huí bù lái
en: I can't get back tonight.
why: Change 得 to 不: 回不来. The direction word 来 stays because the speaker is the place being returned to.

src_py: xué fèi bù gāo wǒ jiāo de qǐ
task: Say the fees are too high to afford.
zh: 学费太高了，我交不起。
py: xué fèi tài gāo le wǒ jiāo bù qǐ
en: The fees are too high; I can't afford them.
why: Cannot afford is V不起, so 交得起 turns into 交不起. 不能交 would mean it is forbidden.

src_py: wǒ hěn è hái chī de xià
task: Say you are full and can't eat any more.
zh: 我吃饱了，再也吃不下了。
py: wǒ chī bǎo le zài yě chī bù xià le
en: I'm full; I can't eat any more.
why: No room left is 吃不下. 再也 goes in front of it, and 了 at the end marks the new state.

src_py: wǒ lái de jí jiāo zuò yè
task: Say it is too late to hand in the homework.
zh: 我来不及交作业了。
py: wǒ lái bù jí jiāo zuò yè le
en: I don't have time to hand in the homework now.
why: 来得及 becomes 来不及, and the verb phrase follows it directly. 了 marks that time has run out.

src: 这个房间很大，住得下十个人。
src_py: zhè ge fáng jiān hěn dà zhù de xià shí ge rén
task: Say it is too small for ten people.
zh: 这个房间太小了，住不下十个人。
py: zhè ge fáng jiān tài xiǎo le zhù bù xià shí ge rén
en: This room is too small; it can't fit ten people.
why: No room for them is V不下: 住不下. The number-phrase object follows the block or is fronted before it.

src_py: wǒ míng tiān kě yǐ qù
task: Say you can't go tomorrow.
zh: 我明天去不了。
py: wǒ míng tiān qù bù liǎo
en: I can't go tomorrow.
why: With no result word, use 不了 (liǎo) after the verb: 去不了. 可以 is dropped because permission is no longer the point.

src: 这点儿工作，一个人做得了。
src_py: zhè diǎn r gōng zuò yī ge rén zuò de liǎo
task: Say one person can't manage all this work.
zh: 这么多工作，一个人做不了。
py: zhè me duō gōng zuò yī ge rén zuò bù liǎo
en: One person can't do this much work.
why: Too much to finish is V不了 (liǎo). 得 becomes 不, and 这么多 gives the reason.

src_py: wǒ yào qù cān jiā péi xùn
task: Say you have changed your mind and are not going after all.
zh: 我不去参加培训了。
py: wǒ bù qù cān jiā péi xùn le
en: I'm not going to the training after all.
why: A changed decision is 不 + verb + 了 (le). It is not 去不了, which would mean unable to go.

src: 这么多项目，我一个人完成得了。
src_py: zhè me duō xiàng mù wǒ yī ge rén wán chéng de liǎo
task: Say you can't manage them alone.
zh: 这么多项目，我一个人完成不了。
py: zhè me duō xiàng mù wǒ yī ge rén wán chéng bù liǎo
en: I can't complete this many projects by myself.
why: Too many to finish is V不了 (liǎo). The positive 得了 becomes 不了, and no 把 or extra 不 is added.

src_py: nǐ kě yǐ jìn qù
task: Say you are not allowed to go in.
zh: 你不能进去。
py: nǐ bù néng jìn qù
en: You're not allowed in.
why: Not allowed is 不能 + verb, so 可以 becomes 不能. 进不去 would say you are physically unable.

src_py: zhè ge xiāng zi wǒ ná de dòng
task: Say it is too heavy for you to lift.
zh: 箱子太重了，我拿不动。
py: xiāng zi tài zhòng le wǒ ná bù dòng
en: The suitcase is too heavy; I can't lift it.
why: Weight is a physical obstacle, so 拿不动 rather than 不能拿.

src: 在图书馆里可以大声说话。
src_py: zài tú shū guǎn lǐ kě yǐ dà shēng shuō huà
task: Say you must not talk loudly in the library.
zh: 在图书馆里不能大声说话。
py: zài tú shū guǎn lǐ bù néng dà shēng shuō huà
en: You can't talk loudly in the library.
why: A rule is 不能 + verb; there is no complement to turn into a potential form here.

src_py: wǒ xiě zhè ge zì xiě de hěn hǎo
task: Say you are unable to write this character well.
zh: 这个字我写不好。
py: zhè ge zì wǒ xiě bù hǎo
en: I can't write this character well.
why: Unable to do it well is potential 写不好, with no 很. 写得不好 would only say it is written poorly.

src_py: tā shuō de hěn qīng chu
task: Say she did not speak clearly.
zh: 她说得不清楚。
py: tā shuō de bù qīng chu
en: She didn't speak clearly.
why: This judges how she spoke, so it is the degree pattern 说得不清楚. The potential 说不清楚 would say she cannot explain it.

src_py: wǒ kàn bù dǒng zhè fèn hé tong
task: Say it with the contract as the topic.
zh: 这份合同我看不懂。
py: zhè fèn hé tong wǒ kàn bù dǒng
en: I can't understand this contract.
why: The topic can be fronted, but never with 把, and never between 看 and 不懂.

src: 我把那个问题讲清楚了。
src_py: wǒ bǎ nà ge wèn tí jiǎng qīng chu le
task: Say you can't explain it clearly. Do not use 把.
zh: 那个问题我讲不清楚。
py: nà ge wèn tí wǒ jiǎng bù qīng chu
en: I can't explain that question clearly.
why: Potential complements do not take 把, so the object moves in front as a topic or follows 讲不清楚.

src_py: nǐ tīng de jiàn
task: Turn it into a positive-negative question.
zh: 你听得见听不见？
py: nǐ tīng de jiàn tīng bù jiàn
en: Can you hear it or not?
why: The full positive and negative forms sit side by side. 吗 is not added, and the complement alone is not doubled.

s: 我听得不懂老师的话。
s_py: wǒ tīng de bù dǒng lǎo shī de huà
zh: 我听不懂老师的话。
py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng lǎo shī de huà
en: I can't understand what the teacher says.
why: The potential negative is 听不懂, with 不 replacing 得. Writing both 得 and 不 is not a possible form.

s: 老师的话我没听得懂。
s_py: lǎo shī de huà wǒ méi tīng de dǒng
zh: 老师的话我没听懂。
py: lǎo shī de huà wǒ méi tīng dǒng
en: I didn't understand what the teacher said.
why: 没 negates a result complement (没听懂), but it can never be put in front of a 得 form such as 听得懂.

s: 昨天我找了半天，也没找到那本书。
s_py: zuó tiān wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān yě méi zhǎo dào nà běn shū
zh: 昨天我找了半天，也没找到那本书。
py: zuó tiān wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān yě méi zhǎo dào nà běn shū
en: I searched for ages yesterday and still did not find the book.
why: This is correct: for one past occasion 没找到 is the natural choice, while 找不到 would describe being unable to find it.

s: 门太小了，桌子搬进不去。
s_py: mén tài xiǎo le zhuō zi bān jìn bù qù
zh: 门太小了，桌子搬不进去。
py: mén tài xiǎo le zhuō zi bān bù jìn qù
en: The door is too small; the table can't be carried in.
why: 不 goes straight after the verb, before the direction word. 搬进不去 puts it after 进.

s: 我想起不来那位老师的名字了。
s_py: wǒ xiǎng qǐ bù lái nà wèi lǎo shī de míng zi le
zh: 我想不起来那位老师的名字了。
py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái nà wèi lǎo shī de míng zi le
en: I can't remember that teacher's name any more.
why: 不 must sit directly after 想, before 起来 as a whole. Splitting 起 and 来 with 不 is wrong.

s: 这个房间的门很大，沙发搬得进去。
s_py: zhè ge fáng jiān de mén hěn dà shā fā bān de jìn qù
zh: 这个房间的门很大，沙发搬得进去。
py: zhè ge fáng jiān de mén hěn dà shā fā bān de jìn qù
en: The door of this room is big; the sofa can be carried in.
why: Correct: positive 得 states it can be done, and the topic 沙发 stands at the front.

s: 这个手机太贵了，我不买起。
s_py: zhè ge shǒu jī tài guì le wǒ bù mǎi qǐ
zh: 这个手机太贵了，我买不起。
py: zhè ge shǒu jī tài guì le wǒ mǎi bù qǐ
en: This phone is too expensive; I can't afford it.
why: Cannot afford is 买不起, with 不 between verb and 起. 不买起 puts 不 before the verb, which is not a form.

s: 对得起，我来晚了。
s_py: duì de qǐ wǒ lái wǎn le
zh: 对不起，我来晚了。
py: duì bù qǐ wǒ lái wǎn le
en: Sorry I'm late.
why: The apology is the fixed 对不起. 对得起 means 'to be worthy of' and cannot be used to say sorry.

s: 这个会议室坐得下二十个人。
s_py: zhè ge huì yì shì zuò de xià èr shí ge rén
zh: 这个会议室坐得下二十个人。
py: zhè ge huì yì shì zuò de xià èr shí ge rén
en: This meeting room can seat twenty people.
why: Correct: V得下 means there is room for them, and the number-phrase object follows the block.

s: 这么多菜，我一个人吃不了完。
s_py: zhè me duō cài wǒ yī ge rén chī bù liǎo wán
zh: 这么多菜，我一个人吃不完。
py: zhè me duō cài wǒ yī ge rén chī bù wán
en: There is so much food that I can't finish it alone.
why: Only one complement fits in the block: 吃不完 or 吃不了. Stacking 不了 and 完 is not possible.

s: 我去不了了，你们去吧。
s_py: wǒ qù bù liǎo le nǐ men qù ba
zh: 我去不了了，你们去吧。
py: wǒ qù bù liǎo le nǐ men qù ba
en: I can't go now, so you go ahead.
why: Correct: 去不了 (liǎo) followed by the 'now' 了 (le) is a regular combination.

s: 这个箱子太重了，我不能拿动。
s_py: zhè ge xiāng zi tài zhòng le wǒ bù néng ná dòng
zh: 这个箱子太重了，我拿不动。
py: zhè ge xiāng zi tài zhòng le wǒ ná bù dòng
en: This suitcase is too heavy; I can't lift it.
why: Being unable to lift it is 拿不动. 不能 does not go in front of a verb + result to mean inability.

s: 这些资料是内部的，你不能带出办公室。
s_py: zhè xiē zī liào shì nèi bù de nǐ bù néng dài chū bàn gōng shì
zh: 这些资料是内部的，你不能带出办公室。
py: zhè xiē zī liào shì nèi bù de nǐ bù néng dài chū bàn gōng shì
en: These documents are internal; you must not take them out of the office.
why: Correct: a rule is expressed with 不能 + verb phrase, and 带出办公室 has no potential complement in it.

s: 我的字写不得好。
s_py: wǒ de zì xiě bù dé hǎo
zh: 我的字写得不好。
py: wǒ de zì xiě de bù hǎo
en: My handwriting isn't good.
why: To say how well something is written use 得 first and then 不好: 写得不好. 写不得好 is not a possible order.

s: 他说得很快，我听不懂。
s_py: tā shuō de hěn kuài wǒ tīng bù dǒng
zh: 他说得很快，我听不懂。
py: tā shuō de hěn kuài wǒ tīng bù dǒng
en: He speaks very fast; I can't understand.
why: Correct: the first clause is the degree pattern with 很, and the second is a potential form without 很.

s: 我把这篇课文背不下来。
s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè piān kè wén bèi bù xià lái
zh: 这篇课文我背不下来。
py: zhè piān kè wén wǒ bèi bù xià lái
en: I can't recite this text from memory.
why: 把 is never used with a potential complement. Front the object as a topic instead.

s: 我看电脑上的字不清楚。
s_py: wǒ kàn diàn nǎo shàng de zì bù qīng chu
zh: 我看不清楚电脑上的字。
py: wǒ kàn bù qīng chu diàn nǎo shàng de zì
en: I can't see the words on the computer clearly.
why: The object cannot be put between 看 and 不清楚. It follows the whole block or goes to the front.

s: 这本书你看得不得懂？
s_py: zhè běn shū nǐ kàn de bù de dǒng
zh: 这本书你看得懂看不懂？
py: zhè běn shū nǐ kàn de dǒng kàn bù dǒng
en: Can you understand this book or not?
why: The pair must repeat the whole form (看得懂看不懂) or the verb (看不看得懂). 看得不得懂 puts 得 and 不 side by side, which is not a form.

s: 你听不听得见我说话？
s_py: nǐ tīng bù tīng de jiàn wǒ shuō huà
zh: 你听不听得见我说话？
py: nǐ tīng bù tīng de jiàn wǒ shuō huà
en: Can you hear me speaking?
why: Correct: V不V得R is the colloquial question form for potential complements and takes no 吗.

s: 你听得见听不得见？
s_py: nǐ tīng de jiàn tīng bù de jiàn
zh: 你听得见听不见？
py: nǐ tīng de jiàn tīng bù jiàn
en: Can you hear it or not?
why: In the negative half 不 replaces 得: 听不见. 听不得见 keeps both, which is not a form.
